    For employers

    Warehouse employee

    Echt
    Salary €15.04 / Hourly
    Categories Logistics warehousing
    Sector Logistics
    Employment type Fixed-term
    Work schedule Full time
    Accepted languages English,  Dutch
    Stable shifts
    Link copied
    Apply now

    You receive an all-in gross hourly wage of €17,08. This amount consists of your base salary of €15,04 per hour, supplemented with ADV allowance, holiday allowance, and profit sharing. Depending on your duties, you may also receive additional allowances, such as shift allowance or cold allowance, which can further increase your final hourly wage.

     

    As a warehouse employee at Veris Bouwmaterialen, you work for a leading company in the building materials sector. Veris supports more than 100 branches in the Netherlands and Belgium. They operate under well‑known brands such as Bouwcenter, Bouwpunt and Stiho. The company supplies many types of materials for construction professionals and private customers. You help prepare building materials for transport and support daily warehouse tasks. You work in a clean and organized warehouse with a friendly team. We guide you from the first day and help you learn your tasks step by step. 

     

     

    Your daily tasks 

    You help move and prepare building materials in the warehouse. You will: 

     

    • Lift packages and boxes of different weights 
    • Load and unload trucks 
    • Pick orders 
    • Put products and packages on pallets 
    • Drive a reach truck 
    • Prepare goods for shipment and label packages correctly 

     

     

    Your working schedule 

    You work from Monday to Friday in two shifts. You can expect: 

     

    • Morning shift from 06:00 to 14:30 
    • Afternoon shift from 14:30 to 23:00 
    • Occasional Saturday work 

     

     

    What you need to bring 

    You enjoy warehouse work and working with building materials. You have: 

     

    • Experience operating a reach truck 
    • A valid reach truck certificate 
    • Availability to work in shifts 
    • Good communication skills in English or Dutch 

     

     

    Why this job fits you 

    This job suits you if you like active and practical warehouse tasks. This job is perfect if you want: 

     

    • Clear tasks with a steady work routine 
    • A job where you stay active and use warehouse equipment 
    • A role in a strong and well‑known organization in the building materials sector 

    Benefits of this job opening

    Working at Veris Bouwmaterialen means working for a stable and well‑organised company. Employees work in a practical environment with clear processes and responsibilities. Training and support are provided to help people learn and do their jobs well. There are opportunities to grow and take on more responsibility over time. Teamwork and cooperation are important in daily work. Veris Bouwmaterialen offers a reliable workplace where people can gain experience and build a long‑term career.
